text:
Olivia Hart: Hey team  Olivia here (first week). Two quick setup asks so I can run e2e infra tests: 
- Link billing account `sandbox-billing-2026` to project `redwood-olivia-sbx` (tiny spend, < $30/mo)
- Need GKE access: roles/container.clusterViewer + roles/container.developer on cluster `redwood-dev-cluster` in europe-west4 and asia-south1 so I can deploy a test sidecar and run some latency experiments
- Also need `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on `sa-olivia@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com` for CI to impersonate for deployments
- AWS cross-account read-only to account `999111222333` and S3 ListObjects on `redwood-model-checkpoints` to compare checkpoint sizes across regions
- Hitting Okta device-flow "invalid_grant" when doing `gcloud auth login`  any quick fixes? Who should I tag for billing link + AWS role? Thanks!

Ben Carter: welcome Olivia! For billing ping @billing-team. For Okta try re-enrolling MFA or run `gcloud auth application-default login` then `gcloud auth login` in separate shell.

Olivia Hart: tried re-enrolling MFA, still saw invalid_grant once but cleared after second attempt. Thanks for the tip.

Priya Rao: tagging infra. Quick Q: Do you need cluster-admin or just developer-level access? We prefer least privilege; cluster-admin only if you need to change node pools.

Olivia Hart: just developer-level for now. I need to deploy manifests and view logs, not change nodes.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-5602 created by Priya Rao. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5602

billing-bot: Billing link request BILL-1605 created for project `redwood-olivia-sbx`. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1605

iam-bot: To apply container roles I need the user principal. Olivia, confirm email. Also note: container.developer implies access to deploy; we will grant `roles/container.clusterViewer` + `roles/container.developer` to your user and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` to CI principal for `sa-olivia` by default.

Olivia Hart: Email is `olivia.hart@redwood.com`. That plan sounds good. Time-limited AWS role (72h) is fine for cross-account.

Priya Rao: Manager approval required for cross-account AWS. Olivia, who is your manager?

Olivia Hart: Manager is Ben Carter  Ben approves the AWS read-only for 72h. Data classification: synthetic/dev prompts only.

sec-bot: Security ack: non-sensitive dev workload OK. Reminder: do not create long-lived SA keys and use token impersonation. We'll audit the SA bindings after expiry.

iam-bot: Applied `roles/container.clusterViewer` and `roles/container.developer` to `olivia.hart@redwood.com` at 1957004400. Granted `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` to CI principal for `sa-olivia@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com` at 1957004415.

ops-bot: AWS temporary role request created for account `999111222333` with 72h expiry. GKE bindings applied; please verify you can `kubectl get pods --context redwood-dev-eu` and deploy a test manifest.

Olivia Hart: Verified I can list pods and deploy a tiny nginx sidecar in europe-west4. Also can assume AWS role and list S3 keys. Everything working on my end :tada:

Priya Rao: Great. Leaving OPS-5602 open until billing link is visible and the 72h AWS role is confirmed active in the ops ticket.

billing-bot: Billing linked at 1957004475. Olivia, confirm project appears in Billing console.

Olivia Hart: Confirmed billing visibility and deployment tested in both regions. Thanks everyone for the quick help!

ops-bot: Updated OPS-5602 with BILL-1605 and AWS request reference. Closing follow-ups once AWS role expires and audit completes.
